attackers_goals: Gain access to the data in the compromised mailbox.
description: An attacker may use PowerShell to change the Client Access Settings (CAS) for a mailbox, hence gaining access to the data.
investigative_actions: Examine the PowerShell command to identify which mailbox's access setting has been modified. Verify that the change in the client access setting was executed by a trusted source.
name: Mailbox Client Access Setting (CAS) changed
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
